title: Backend ve Gömülü Yazılım Geliştirme Mühendisi
description: ASELSAN Ulaşım, Güvenlik, Enerji, Otomasyon ve Sağlık Sistemleri (UGES) Sektör Başkanlığı bünyesinde Macunköy yerleşkesindeki faaliyetlerimizde bize güç katacak; üniversitelerin Bilgisayar, Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun Backend ve Gömülü Yazılım Geliştirme Mühendisi çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. BU POZİSYONDA EN ÖNEM VERDİĞİMİZ YETKİNLİKLER VE DENEYİMLER Yazılım yaşam döngüsü evrelerine hakim, Geleneksel ve çevik geliştirme yöntemlerine aşina ve ekip içinde aktif katkı sunan, C/C++ programlama dillerini kullanarak backend/gömülü yazılım projelerinde görev almış olan, Tercihen Java ile backend servis geliştirme çalışmalarına aşina, Tercihen, gömülü Linux’da tecrübesi olan, Tercihen, gerçek zamanlı işletim sistemlerinde deneyimli, Tercihen, uç cihazlarda yapay zeka çıkarımı (Edge AI Inference / ONNX Runtime vb.) konusunda deneyimli, Tercihen, Linux ve Windows ortamlarında cross platform yazılım geliştirme tecrübesi olan, Tercihen, hata ayıklama ve profilleme araçlarını (GDB, Valgrind, perf, sanitizer'lar) etkin kullanabilen, Konfigürasyon yönetim sistemi (Git) ve sürüm kontrol süreçlerine hakim, Teknik dokümantasyon hazırlamaya ve güncel tutmaya yatkın, Görev kritik (Mission Critical) sistemlerde çalışma konusunda bilinçli ve disiplinli, Gerektiğinde seyahat ve sahada çalışmaya engeli bulunmayan. SENDEN NELER BEKLİYORUZ? Sensör projelerinde kullanılacak/kullanılan yazılımları tasarlamak, gerçeklemek ve idame ettirmek, Sistem mühendisliği, test, kalite vb. paydaşlar ile yakın iş birliği içinde sürdürülebilir ve güvenilir yazılım çözümleri üretmek, Projelerdeki C/C++ ve Java tabanlı backend ve gömülü yazılımları geliştirmek ve idame ettirmek, DevOps ve CI/CD hatlarıyla entegre test edilebilir ve sürdürülebilir yazılım geliştirmek. Yapılan tasarımların, kurumsal araçları kullanarak dokümantasyonunu hazırlamak/güncel tutmak, Kaynak kısıtlı donanımlarda performans ve bellek optimizasyonu yapmak, Gereksinim analizine katılmak ve yazılım mimarisi tasarımına katkı sağlamak, Kod gözden geçirme süreçlerinde aktif rol almak, birim ve entegrasyon testleri yazmak, Sistem entegrasyonu ve saha testlerinde görev almak, sahadan gelen hataları analiz etmek, Yeni teknolojileri araştırmak ve prototip geliştirmek. İşe alım kriterlerimizi ASELSAN internet sayfamızda Kariyer Sekmesinde bulunan İşe Alım Sürecimiz alanından inceleyerek iş başvuru formumuzu doldur. ASELSAN ailesinin bir parçası olarak yerli ve milli projelerdeki başarımızda senin de imzan olsun. Biz Kimiz? Alanında dünyanın en iyi ürünlerini yapma, oyun değiştirici teknolojiler geliştirme ve ihracat odaklı büyüme hedeflerimizle ülkemize ve dünyanın dört bir yanındaki kullanıcılarımıza değer katan küresel bir markayız.

title: Backend Developer
description: PlusMinusOne is a mobile startup studio that focuses on developing and marketing its own apps that are used and loved by millions of people around the world. Our products collectively reach more than a half-million new users every month in the US market alone. Our team works in hybrid model with offices in San Francisco and Istanbul. We have been building mobile products focused on Business, Photo & Video, and Education categories in the App Store mainly for the US market since 2016. And in each of these categories, our goal is the same: provide actual value to people with the best mobile user experience. We’re in an exciting period of growth and are looking for Backend Developer who will help us shape the future of mobile. What we are looking for: 3+ years building production backend services with Node.js / TypeScript (NestJS is a plus) Solid experience with PostgreSQL and Redis — schema design, indexing, query performance Experience designing and building REST APIs Comfortable with Docker and containerized deployments; hands-on Kubernetes experience is a strong plus Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and designing CI/CD pipelines Working knowledge of AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, Secrets Manager) Able to debug real problems from logs and metrics (Prometheus / Grafana) Strong grasp of clean architecture and fundamental design principles for scalable systems Strong analytical and time management skills, and a track record of working well in an agile team Product-minded: you care about the user impact of what you ship, and you're comfortable pushing back on requirements when something doesn't make sense Great bonus if you have: Event streaming and data pipelines: Kafka, CDC (Debezium), ClickHouse or BigQuery GitOps with ArgoCD, autoscaling with Karpenter / KEDA Integrating LLM APIs into real products (RAG, evaluation, cost/latency trade-offs) Python for tooling and data work Your responsibilities will be: Building backend services for our mobile and web products from the ground up Designing and refining integrations between our applications and third-party services Deploying and operating services on Kubernetes — scaling, tuning and keeping them healthy in production Owning what you ship: monitoring, alerting and debugging your services in production Working with our event and data pipelines that power product analytics Bringing new technology and ideas to the table Influencing cross-team initiatives and mentoring mid-level and junior backend engineers Participating in planning, estimating tasks, reviewing code and pairing with teammates What we offer: Opportunity to make an impact on millions of global users' life and the future of mobile Chance to be a part of a passionate and driven team where everyone’s ideas are valued A hybrid work environment with 3 days a week at the Kabataş Istanbul office Extra 5 days of PM1 paid vacation from the first year, increasing with seniority Performance-based bonus paid twice a year Ability to own a stock option after the first year Private health insurance package Lunch and transportation allowance Reimbursement package for any education, course, sports activities, hobbies, etc. A Macbook, iPhone, magic mouse, magic keyboard, and any other hardware that you need to deliver your best work. Let's shape the future of mobile together!

title: Full Stack Developer (.Net + React.js)
description: We have come a long way from being an ambitious start-up to becoming a fully export-oriented offshore development center serving a long list of prestigious clients across the globe; enriching our experience, expertise, and portfolio along the way. After a humble start with open source technologies, we worked our way up into becoming an authority on a number of key fields- the development of large enterprise applications, mobile applications, applications that facilitate hardware-software interaction to name a few. Following the motto “Consistently delivering quality solutions”, our team currently has 10 exclusive niche techies, with 100+ successful projects under their belts, covering a very wide range of technologies, solutions, and industry verticals. We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to join Path team. Requirements 8+ years of professional software development experience Deep understanding and demonstrated expertise in .Net Framework and C# libraries Minimum 5 years React.js or Vue.js knowledge is must Expert in .Net Technologies (MVC, Web Forms) and C# language Experience in RESTful & SOAP service technologies Knowledge of object-oriented programming Experience in relational databases, ability to write functions Experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB Experience with Redis, Docker and RabbitMQ Capable of writing unit tests Deep understanding of Microservices Technologies Nice to have Experience with Websocket Experience with Elastic Search Experience with Cloud technologies

title: Backend Team Leader
description: Rapsodo is a global sports technology company with offices in Singapore, the United States, Türkiye, Japan, and Malaysia. We develop data-driven sports analytics products that combine computer vision, AI, hardware, and cloud technologies to help athletes measure, understand, and improve their performance. Our products deliver accurate, real-time performance insights in demanding environments, supporting professional athletes, coaches, and sports organizations around the world. At Rapsodo, engineers take ownership from concept to production, working across multidisciplinary teams to build innovative products that transform complex motion into actionable insights at global scale. About The Role We are looking for a Backend Team Leader to lead our backend engineering team and take ownership of the technical direction, development practices, and delivery of our backend services and APIs. In this role, you will combine strong hands-on backend expertise with technical leadership and people management. Our backend services power sports devices, mobile apps, desktop applications, and web dashboards, and handle high volumes of real-time and analytical data. You will work closely with Product, Frontend, Mobile, Desktop, Firmware, DevOps, QA, and other engineering teams to build scalable, reliable, secure, and high-performance systems. Key Responsibilities Lead and support the backend engineering team in delivering high-quality, scalable, and maintainable services Provide technical direction and own backend architecture and technology decisions, including service boundaries, data models, API design, and integration patterns Establish and maintain backend development standards, best practices, and coding guidelines Participate in system design, code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions Work closely with Product, Frontend, Mobile, Desktop, Firmware, and QA teams to translate product requirements into effective technical solutions and well-defined APIs Own backend development planning, prioritization, and delivery in collaboration with relevant stakeholders Ensure the reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency of backend services in production, including observability, incident response, and root cause analysis Collaborate with the DevOps team on CI/CD, deployment strategies, infrastructure needs, and release management Apply security and compliance best practices across services, data handling, authentication, and access control Identify technical risks, dependencies, technical debt, and improvement opportunities, and proactively address them Drive improvements in code quality, system performance, development processes, and engineering efficiency Mentor and coach backend engineers through technical guidance, feedback, and knowledge sharing Support the growth and development of team members and contribute to hiring and onboarding activities when needed Foster a collaborative, accountable, and continuous-learning team culture Stay current with modern backend technologies, cloud services, tools, and industry practices Contribute hands-on to development, particularly in complex or technically critical areas Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field Strong professional experience in backend software development Strong proficiency in Go and/or Node.js (TypeScript), with the ability to work across both Solid understanding of backend architecture, service design, data modeling, and distributed systems Experience designing and maintaining REST and/or gRPC APIs consumed by web, mobile, and desktop clients Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases, data access patterns, and query performance Experience with messaging and event-driven architectures (e.g., Pub/Sub, message queues) for ingesting and processing device and application data Experience building backend services that communicate with connected devices, including knowledge of IoT protocols such as MQTT, device provisioning and authentication, telemetry ingestion, and handling intermittent connectivity Experience building and operating scalable, production-grade services, including monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting in production Experience building or supporting cloud-based applications and services, preferably in a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environment Experience with containerized deployments, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and software engineering best practices Good understanding of application security, authentication and authorization, and secure data handling Previous experience leading a backend team or taking technical ownership of a backend product or domain Experience mentoring and developing engineers Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Ability to balance technical quality, business priorities, and delivery timelines Nice to Have Experience working in product-focused, fast-paced technology environments and globally distributed engineering teams Familiarity with microservices, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), modular monolith architectures, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code Experience with identity and authentication platforms such as Auth0 or Firebase Auth Exposure to data pipelines, analytics, machine learning, computer vision, or other data-intensive applications Experience with IoT or connected hardware products, including device data ingestion, firmware integration, and real-time data processing Familiarity with GDPR or similar compliance frameworks and experience in sports technology or consumer products

title: E-Commerce Manager
description: Kenvue Is Currently Recruiting For a E-Commerce Manager What We Do At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent. Who We Are Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here. Role Reports To E-Ticaret Lideri Location: Europe/Middle East/Africa, Turkey, Istanbul, Istanbul Work Location: Hybrid What You Will Do About the Role We are seeking a commercially driven eCommerce Manager to own marketplace execution and performance across Türkiye. Reporting to the Head of eCommerce, this role combines marketplace key account management, distributor operations, eCommerce marketing partnership, budget and profitability management, and cross functional coordination with local brand and regional teams. The successful candidate will translate strategy into practical, measurable business outcomes. Key Responsibilitie s Commercial Performance, Budget & Profitability Own day to day sales and commercial performance across Trendyol, Amazon, Hepsiburada, Yemeksepeti, Getir and other relevant channels. Develop and execute marketplace specific commercial plans, pricing, assortment and promotional calendars aligned with brand priorities. Own budget tracking, commercial investment monitoring, profitability analysis and recurring financial performance reporting. Prepare forecasts and performance reviews; explain actuals versus budget, sales, margin and spending variances, and recommend corrective actions. Evaluate promotional economics, investment returns and platform profitability to support sustainable growth. Partner with the Head of eCommerce on annual planning, financial decisions and investment approvals. Distributor Management & Marketplace Operations Own the day to day relationship with the eCommerce distributor and third party operations partner. Coordinate order preparation, purchase order follow up, replenishment planning, fulfillment and operational issue resolution. Lead monthly distributor reconciliations, validating sales, inventory, returns and applicable operational and financial records; resolve discrepancies with Finance and partners. Monitor stock levels, inventory health, sell through, aging and out of stock risks; drive availability and stock optimization. Ensure accurate marketplace listings, pricing, campaign implementation and customer facing execution. Work with Supply Chain, Finance and logistics stakeholders to improve service levels and operational efficiency. Brand Partnership & eCommerce Marketing Act as a key stakeholder and commercial partner for local brand teams in eCommerce marketing planning and execution. Translate brand strategies, innovation launches and campaign priorities into platform specific activation plans. Collaborate closely with brand, media and agency teams on retail media, sponsored search, display and marketplace visibility initiatives. Connect media plans to commercial objectives, availability, content quality, pricing and conversion. Review campaign KPIs, ROAS and business contribution with agencies and recommend optimization. Ensure consistent brand representation and effective digital shopper experience across marketplaces. Digital Shelf & Conversion Excellence Own digital shelf standards for titles, descriptions, images, attributes and enhanced content. Improve search visibility, discoverability, product page quality and conversion performance. Track content compliance, availability, search rankings, ratings and reviews; act on gaps. Use competitor benchmarking and shopper insights to prioritize improvements. Analytics, Reporting & Business Insights Deliver regular platform, brand and SKU level reporting on sales, traffic, conversion, budget, margin, profitability and operational KPIs. Translate data into commercial recommendations, clear priorities and corrective actions. Measure promotional effectiveness, investment efficiency and marketplace growth drivers. Improve dashboards, reporting processes and analytical automation where practical. Regional & Cross Functional Stakeholder Management Maintain active communication with regional eCommerce and commercial teams, sharing market updates, business performance and local requirements. Coordinate regional initiatives and ensure local execution aligns with agreed regional priorities. Work closely with Brand Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Demand Planning and media teams. Manage relationships with marketplaces, distributor, external agencies and service providers, ensuring follow through and accountability. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Engineering or a related field. 4–6 years of relevant experience in eCommerce, digital commerce, marketplace key account management or commercial roles. Hands on understanding of Turkish marketplaces, preferably Trendyol, Amazon and Hepsiburada. Experience in commercial planning, budget management, profitability reporting and promotional execution. Understanding of distributor operations, order coordination, inventory management and reconciliation processes. Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation and problem solving skills. Fluent Turkish and English, written and spoken. Preferred Experience in FMCG, consumer health, beauty or personal care. Exposure to retail media, digital shelf tools, Power BI or marketplace owned platform and analytics. Experience working with brand teams, regional stakeholders, agencies and third party operating partners. Key Competencies Commercial ownership and financial discipline. Hands on operational execution and distributor management. Cross functional influence, agility and continuous improvement. What Success Looks Like Sustainable marketplace sales growth with disciplined budget and profitability management. Accurate monthly distributor reconciliations, reliable order execution and healthy inventory. Strong partnership with brand and regional teams, resulting in effective eCommerce marketing activation. Better product availability, digital shelf quality, visibility and conversion. Clear, actionable performance reporting and proactive issue resolution. Kenvue is now part of Kimberly-Clark. Continue exploring opportunities at jobs.kenvue.com. If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.
